package consumer_test

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"testing"

	"github.com/aws/aws-lambda-go/lambda"

	"github.com/asteroid-computing/go-lambda-edge"
	"github.com/asteroid-computing/go-lambda-edge/actionheader"
	"github.com/asteroid-computing/go-lambda-edge/authn"
	"github.com/asteroid-computing/go-lambda-edge/authz"
	"github.com/asteroid-computing/go-lambda-edge/iamproof"
	"github.com/asteroid-computing/go-lambda-edge/identity"
)

func TestPublicComposition(t *testing.T) {
	// Explicit verifier stub: constructing this caller does not verify a token.
	claims, err := identity.NewClaims(map[string]any{"iss": "https://issuer.example/pool", "sub": "alice"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	caller, err := identity.NewJWT(claims, identity.SourceLocallyVerifiedToken)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	authentication, err := authn.New(authn.Config{Bearer: func(context.Context, string) (identity.Caller, error) {
		return caller, nil
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	policy, err := authz.JWTSubject("https://issuer.example/pool", "alice")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	selector, err := actionheader.NewSelector("Action")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	h, err := authentication.Handler(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		action, err := selector.Parse(r.Header)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "bad action", 400)
			return
		}
		if action != "read" {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		err = policy.Authorize(r.Context(), authz.Request{Caller: identity.FromContext(r.Context()), Action: action})
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "forbidden", 403)
			return
		}
		w.WriteHeader(204)
	}))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	adapter, err := edge.New(h)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var registered lambda.Handler = adapter
	_, err = registered.Invoke(t.Context(), []byte(`{"httpMethod":"GET","path":"/","headers":{"authorization":"Bearer fixture","action":"read"},"requestContext":{"apiId":"synthetic"}}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = lambda.NewHandler(adapter.HandleV1)
	_ = lambda.NewHandler(adapter.HandleV2)
	stream, err := edge.NewStreaming(h)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = lambda.NewHandler(stream.Handle)
	_ = lambda.NewHandler(stream.HandleV1)
	// Construction performs no STS call or server-credential lookup.
	if _, err := iamproof.NewVerifier("eu-west-2", "consumer.test"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
